windowsAuth: Uses Windows authentication; set a SQL login after import.
entraAuth: Uses Microsoft Entra sign-in; set a SQL login after import.
adsKeepsPasswords: Azure Data Studio keeps passwords in your credential store, so set it after import.
noUsername: Username not found; set it after import.
noPassword: No saved password; set it after import.
pwInFile: The password is in a file inside the container; set it after import.
trustsAll: The container trusts every connection, so no password is needed.
rootRandom: The root password was generated when the container first started and printed to its log; set it after import.
noRootUser: No root user is set, so the server takes connections without signing in.
portNotPublished: {what} Its port {port} is not published to this computer, so it cannot be reached. Recreate it with "-p {port}:{port}" (or a "ports:" entry in compose) to connect.
hostNetwork: It shares this computer's network, so it listens on port {port} directly.
portSuggests: The image does not say what it is; port {port} suggests it.
pwFromEnv: The password comes from the container's environment.
noPwEnv: No password in its environment; set it after import.
socketDenied: Docker is running, but this account may not read its socket ({socket}). Add yourself to the docker group ("sudo usermod -aG docker $USER"), sign out and back in, then run this again.
namedPipe: HeidiSQL connects over a named pipe; this imports it as TCP.
sshPwNotImported: The SSH password is not imported.
windowsNoUser: Uses Windows authentication, which has no username to import; set a SQL login after import.
portOpen: Port {port} is open, the usual port for {engine}, but it did not say what it is.
defaultUser: No password is known; set it after import (the username is {engine}'s default).
noCreds: No username or password is known; set them after import.
workbenchKeychain: MySQL Workbench keeps passwords in your keychain, so set it after import.
localSocket: Workbench connects over a local socket; this imports it as TCP on port 3306.
localNetworkDenied: macOS is not letting SnoutData reach your local network. Allow it in System Settings, Privacy & Security, Local Network, then run this again.
announced: Announced on the local network as "{instance}".
pgadminEncrypted: pgAdmin encrypts saved passwords with its master password, so set it after import.
libpqService: Uses the libpq service "{service}", which cannot be imported.
unixSocket: A Unix socket entry; only TCP connections can be imported.
anyDatabase: Any database on this server; the connection opens its default.
tookTooLong: {source} took too long to answer, so it was skipped.
ssmsEncrypted: SSMS encrypts saved passwords for this Windows account, so set it after import.
tablePlusKeychain: TablePlus keeps passwords in your Keychain, so set it after import.
asmImport: Uses AWS Secrets Manager; set an AWS profile or rely on your default AWS credentials after import. Open it and save it once before it connects.
awsRegion: AWS region not detected; set it after import.
datagripNoPw: Passwords aren't imported from DataGrip; set it after import.
navicatNoPw: Passwords aren't imported from Navicat; set it after import.
